Short, wavy dark brown hair styled messy on top accompanies a short, dense beard and mustache covering the lower jaw and upper lip. This middle-aged individual has an oval face shape with strong bone structure, prominent cheekbones with moderate zygomatic flare, and a defined continuous jawline with a rounded chin. The face features thick, dark, soft-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with a positive canthal tilt, and a straight nose with a rounded tip. The forehead is average in height with a low hairline and balanced temporal recession, while the lips have medium fullness with a well-defined cupid's bow.
